notes.title: Rancher: A New Life - Devlog #1
notes.content:
﻿[previewyoutube="WzYQI5RAsPo;full"][/previewyoutube]Howdy Ranchers! ﻿

It’s time to share with you what's happening behind the doors of our Ranch. ﻿

Sit on your porch, grab something to drink, and allow us to show you the current state of our game.

We talk about what we are currently working on and share a little secret with you.

What secret? Watch the first devlog and see for yourself. ﻿
 
Remember to add Rancher: A new life to your Wishlist!
